ties: round equal-opponent mean scores to12 decimals; average ranks; inversion rate excludes reference ties and reports predicted ties separately
reference: independent historical submission IDs; mostly older than recent pool, not current-frontier ground truth
inference: descriptive, no formal significance from overlapping leave-one-out cases; distinct task ID not proof of independent random seeds
execution: historical saved games, no rerun of policies; calendar-time/engine/resource effects not controlled
